item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: Jared Kushner and Israel's prime minister meet in attempt to move Gaza ceasefire plan forward, U.S. focus on Iran draws key resources from Asia, voters head to the polls for primaries Tuesday.

item.title: Part of a key firearms law lapsed following a federal court decision. What happens now?
item.description: A federal judge's decision in Texas has major implications for the National Firearms Act. What does this mean for certain guns and other weapons?

item.title: Palestinian American returns to his West Bank home, under siege by Israeli settlers
item.description: The Palestinian American whose home in the occupied West Bank has been besieged by Israeli settlers traveled to his property on Monday to join other family members who have been defending it.

item.title: הם נלחמו עבור ארה"ב באפגניסטן. עכשיו הם דואגים לאבד את הגרין קארד שלהם
item.description: כאשר ארה"ב נסוגה מאפגניסטן לפני חמש שנים, אלפי אפגנים שסייעו לחיילים אמריקאים הובאו לכאן כדי לשקם את חייהם. אבל עכשיו, יש החוששים שארה"ב תרצה לשלוח אותם בחזרה.
